properties.description: find_tools' index of a field's own words for reflow2's types (req:the-vocabulary-is-served-in-a-fields-own-terms): each term in schema/*.yaml `also_called` indexes the served tools that write its type (a node type's constructors; an edge type's typed helpers, else the constructors of the one type it is pinned to, so PREMISE_OF and CONCLUDES name add_inference). A query that uses a term's words, consecutive and whole, adds what an exact name match adds (8 x discrimination, inside the length normalisation). Holds edge_tools, which describe_schema's term lookup reads for `drawn_by`.
properties.name: field_terms.rs
